scientific.integrity: The published FedExP server rule is specialized exactly to two deterministic symmetric scalar quadratics. The fixed-point derivative, nonzero two-cycle, and its local multiplier are derived in closed form and independently replayed.
limitations: Two equally weighted scalar quadratic clients with symmetric shifted minimizers.
One deterministic full-batch local gradient step and full participation.
The two-cycle stability statement is local; its full basin is not classified.
The exact-local-solve witness uses a larger client step than the conservative sufficient step in the source's general convergence theorem.
No claim is made about practical epsilon choices on realistic datasets.

title: FedExP undergoes a sharp epsilon-driven period doubling under client-update cancellation
